support.title: Support
support.prompt: What would you like to know?

brightness.q: What's the difference between brightness (starlight) and confidence?
brightness.a: Starlight is how much you've captured in that area; confidence is how well SecondB's estimate has been verified. The two move independently.

plan.q: Does a paid plan make it smarter?
plan.a: No. Answer quality is the same on every plan. Only the limits on counts, retention, and export differ.

call.a: Recordings are transcribed over an encrypted connection on the AI server, and the original audio is deleted from your device right after. Only the text and signals are kept, encrypted.

connect.title: Data sync
connect.lead: Import records from other apps to update your stars. Processing starts on your device.
connect.consent: Original content isn't stored. Only information drawn from it is saved, encrypted. You can disconnect and delete it at any time.
